question: Does HOLD/FLIP composition drift predict long-horizon failures and does targeted training repair them beyond equal-operation supervised training?
purpose: One fixed composition-consistency training candidate and prospective new-seed mechanism test, not Gate1.

task_search.heldout_rule: One coefficient. Six new training seeds, disjoint diagnosis/eval namespaces, all8cells. Old checkpoints descriptive only.

branches.success: Report supported local prediction/intervention/repair chain only if all preregistered links pass.
branches.failure: Retain failures, strong INV, and no coefficient/seed search; conclude scoped non-support.
branches.borderline: Separate repair from mechanism; no retrospective threshold changes.
